demos.title: ortho-japan
demos.desc: Japan drawn straight onto the globe from government vector tiles, with real-scale terrain and PLATEAU 3D cities that rise as you zoom.

img.alt: PLATEAU 3D buildings of central Tokyo with the Rainbow Bridge, rendered from GSI vector tiles

demos.title: ortho-equal
demos.desc: The globe unrolls into the Equal Earth map — every country at its true size, names in 26 languages.

demos.title: World earthquakes
demos.desc: Earthquakes from USGS, month by month, above and below the surface of the globe.

demos.title: Satellites in orbit now
demos.desc: Satellites computed from their orbits in your browser, moving in the same frame as the Earth.

demos.title: Tellus satellite data
demos.desc: Radar and optical satellite images from Tellus, laid on the 3D globe.

demos.title: Nations of the World
demos.desc: A card for every country — flag, outline and basic facts.

demos.title: ortho-nl
demos.desc: The same engine in another country: the Netherlands and its 3DBAG buildings.

demos.title: Landmarks in 3D
demos.desc: Tokyo Tower and other landmarks as PLATEAU LOD3 models, placed on the globe.

demos.title: census2020
demos.desc: Japan's 2020 census on the globe — small areas, disaster risk and land parcels.

demos.title: Japan's open GIS data
demos.desc: Open data from Japan's ministries — cadastral maps, census small areas, national land data — to view and convert.

demos.title: ortho-solar
demos.desc: The Solar System around the Sun, with the planets and their moons where they are now.

demos.title: GeoPBF
demos.desc: Drop a GIS file, check it on the globe, write it in another format — 18 formats in, 14 out. The file never leaves your machine.

demos.title: geoedit
demos.desc: Draw and edit shapes on the globe, and save them as GeoPBF.

demos.title: Scenes editor
demos.desc: Make a camera tour of the globe and record it as a video.

demos.title: Maps
demos.desc: Maps people published from their own GitHub — open them on the globe.
